Citizens of Rome!

The Senate hereby presents you with its latest localization additions... and a number of fixes.



New and improved translations have been added.  

These new translations are in experimental stage and are pending to be proofread by our community. 

However they should be significantly better than the previous ones.

Existing translations that have been previously proofread by our community are still being used.

If you see any bugs or errors, please report them and we will address them as soon as possible.

We would love your feedback on them, so that we can constantly improve them.



If you would like to join the proofreading effort join our discord to find out more!

Changelog v2.0.9 

Pubic hair

- Added 3 types of pubic hair: Strip, Sparse and Messy.

Gameplay additions

- God Seeker will be available at her original location to have sex with after completing the Mars storyline.

Archery update

- Camera handling when holding the bow will be much more consistent now.
- Movement speed while aiming (while holding RMB) is decreased.
- Decreased arrows fall off amount and distance.
- Fixed an issue where aiming acceleration was getting reduced when turning fast.
- Decreased default sensitivity. (you can adjust it to your liking through the settings)

Quest Helper

We have opted in favor of the native Unreal solution, TAAU (Temporal AntiAliasing Upscaler). Which works on all hardware and still provides the necessary performance benefits.

Citizens!
